definitions.gloss: manju, steamed bun with sweet filling
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese confection consisting of a wheat or rice flour outer layer filled with sweet bean paste (anko).

examples.japanese: お{土産|みやげ}に{温泉|おんせん}{饅頭|まんじゅう}を{買|か}いました。
examples.english: I bought onsen manju as a souvenir.

examples.japanese: {饅頭|まんじゅう}の{中|なか}には{餡子|あんこ}が{入|はい}っています。
examples.english: There is sweet bean paste inside manju.

examples.japanese: {紅白|こうはく}{饅頭|まんじゅう}は{祝|いわ}いの{席|せき}で{配|くば}られます。
examples.english: Red and white manju are distributed at celebrations.

notes:
{饅頭|まんじゅう} is a classic Japanese sweet with Chinese origins.

Types:
- {温泉|おんせん}{饅頭|まんじゅう} (hot spring manju) - brown, common souvenir
- {紅白|こうはく}{饅頭|まんじゅう} (red and white) - for celebrations
- {薄皮|うすかわ}{饅頭|まんじゅう} (thin-skinned)
- {酒|さけ}{饅頭|まんじゅう} (sake-flavored dough)
- {葛|くず}{饅頭|まんじゅう} (kudzu starch wrapper)

Filling:
- Usually {餡子|あんこ} (sweet bean paste)
- {こし餡|あん} (smooth) or {粒餡|つぶあん} (chunky)

Cultural significance:
- Popular souvenir item ({お土産|みやげ})
- Given at weddings, celebrations ({紅白|こうはく})
- Associated with Buddhist temples (original purpose)

Phrases:
- 「{饅頭|まんじゅう}{怖|こわ}い」- from a famous rakugo story
